method: Three fresh-process repetitions per mode/harness/scenario; raw reports under ignored artifacts/memory-build-2026-10-07. No forced GC in paired benchmark or 12 ordinary stage runs. Two GC diagnostics separate.

limitations: Current-process memory only; RSS includes resident native allocations and mapped pages, not just the V8 heap.
Bounded idle samples are not a guarantee of quiescence; repeat fresh processes to assess variance.
Full SDK import is retained in the module cache and may differ from normal host import paths.
Chat sessions are empty: this measures mounting and loaded-session overhead, not active turns or retained conversation content.
